items.q: We had people, Kay Francis and Jack Oakie

ctx.x: They went for us all the way. I don't know why. We had people, Kay Francis and Jack Oakie, and Georgie Stone and all these big producers and music directors and stars, Bette Davis and all of them come in here, you know, and it was the place to go, you know.
